notes.input: The archive's active input is a bare swap alias and its NIFTY request is commented out. Two separate fully observed BTC and ETH daily perpetual references are bound to swap. This is a controlled input comparison. Neither is asserted to be the archival symbol.
notes.equivalence: After the shared 55-bar warmup, an EMA of finite positive close/reference values is strictly positive. Only its sign enters these order rules. Two native runs with distinct source data give identical complete outputs, and an independent reconstruction matches every entry and exit gate. The active high crossover is unreachable with valid OHLC because its lookback includes the current high.
notes.broker: One base unit, historical cents grid, next-open market orders and an initial 1,000,000 USDT per independent market. Drawdown uses settled P&L. Gross uses the source's zero commission; the after-fees sensitivity applies 0.075% per fill. No liquidity, funding or additional execution model.

coverage: Tested · Daily positive reference comparison and sign proof
